parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with the indication 'chronic kidney disease'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
